P15o: Peer counseling can become peer surveillance, even if the tone is warm. And when things like that are required as pre-reqs for people to get medicine, it can give the gatekeepers power over people right when they are at their most open. Even something couched in words like “willing to be seen” could become a demand that people disclose whatever the group wants them to.
P16q: The boundary is simple. These aren't principles that give the community power over me, they're principles I choose to guide my own practice.
